items.title: Post reaction summary follows the reference padding
items.precondition: Run the feature branch in an isolated acceptance runtime; sign in and open a post with one reaction, then a post with two reaction types.
steps: Inspect the right-side reaction summary for a single icon.
Inspect it again with two or more reaction types.
Click the summary and close the people list dialog.
items.expected: Each reaction sits in a rounded background/ring with 4px padding; glyphs are compact and optically centered; multiple icons retain their slight overlap; the total and people list behavior are unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-19: User manually confirmed the corrected, centered live reaction summary after visual testing.
items.notes: User acceptance confirmed the centered glyph and unchanged summary behavior.

items.title: Comment and photo consumers stay consistent
items.precondition: An isolated acceptance runtime has a reacted comment and a reacted post image available.
steps: Open the reacted comment and inspect its reaction summary.
Open the reacted post image/card and inspect its reaction summary.
Confirm message-bubble reaction badges are visually unchanged.
items.expected: Comment and post-image summaries use the same compact treatment as posts; the separate message badge is unaffected.
items.evidence: 2026-08-19: User confirmed visual testing of the completed change; message reaction badges remain out of scope and unchanged by the single summary renderer edit.
items.notes: The message assertion protects the explicitly out-of-scope consumer.

items.title: Frontend build gates pass
items.precondition: Dependencies are installed in the execution worktree.
items.expected: All commands exit successfully with no errors caused by the change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-19: npm --prefix frontend run lint exited 0 (six existing unrelated warnings); npm --prefix frontend run typecheck exited 0; npm --prefix frontend run build exited 0. Re-run after the Rev 3 centering correction also exited 0 for all three commands.
items.notes: Class-only changes still require the hard typecheck/build gate. Build retains the pre-existing Vite advisory for a >500 kB generated chunk.
